hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: DATASET_NAME
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: should match the second level of concept paths provided by recover.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: manifest_file_uri
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Often in separate spot from core data so needs to be imported separately

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail mkdir ${STUDY_ID,,} cd ${STUDY_ID,,} aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::714862078411:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3 --role-session-name "get-files" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt aws s3 cp ${INPUT_S3_FOLDER_URI} . --recursive curl 'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gap/sstr/report/study/'${STUDY_ID}'.'${VERSION}'/subjects/download?study_accession_version='${STUDY_ID}'.'${VERSION}'&order_col=0&order_dir=asc&filter_text=&data_format=row&columns=SUBJECT_ID%20%2C%20CONSENT%2C%20consent_abbreviation%20%2C%20dbgap_subject_id' \ -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Connection: keep-alive' > telemetry_report.tsv
aws s3 cp ${manifest_file_uri} . unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-2b115560-c8c4-4cec-8418-537a35f9c192' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='recoverdb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="${DATASET_NAME,,}_${VERSION,,}"
#create db if not exists echo "creating new database" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" createdb $DB --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" -U $conn_user
echo "testing connection to new db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
echo "Establishing necessary schemas" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "ALTER DATABASE $DB set client_min_messages=warning" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS input" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS resources" \ -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS tablefunc"
#adds appended suffix to common varids for caregiver and congenital to avoid overlap with each other/peds general export DATASET_SUFFIX='' if [[ ${DATASET_NAME} == *'caregiver'* ]]; then export DATASET_SUFFIX='_ca'; elif [[ ${DATASET_NAME} == *'congenital'* ]]; then export DATASET_SUFFIX='_co'; fi
echo "add table to resources schema with key-value pairs useful for metadata generation" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS resources.meta_utils" \ -c "CREATE TABLE resources.meta_utils (key text, value text)" \ -c "insert into resources.meta_utils (key, value) values ('study_id', '${STUDY_ID}'), ('dataset_name', '${DATASET_NAME}'), ('dataset_suffix', '${DATASET_SUFFIX}');"
#file list is sorted in reverse to put the longest run (answerdata) last and catch issues in other files early ls . | sort -r > file_list.txt rm -f -r formatted_files table_scripts mkdir formatted_files mkdir table_scripts while read FILE; do FILE_EXT="${FILE##*.}" TABLE_NAME=`echo $FILE | cut -d "_" -f 4`; TABLE_NAME=${TABLE_NAME,,}; if [[ ${FILE,,} == *"biostats"* ]]; then TABLE_NAME="derived_${TABLE_NAME}" fi echo $TABLE_NAME
if [[ ! -z $TABLE_NAME ]] && [[ $TABLE_NAME != "" ]] && [[ $TABLE_NAME != $FILE ]]; then SCHEMA_NAME='input' if [[ $FILE_EXT == "csv" ]]; then echo "processing $FILE as $FILE_EXT with table name $TABLE_NAME" iconv -t UTF-8 -c $FILE | csvformat -v > formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv elif [[ $FILE_EXT == "tsv" ]]; then echo "processing $FILE as $FILE_EXT with table name $TABLE_NAME" iconv -t UTF-8 -c $FILE | csvformat -t > formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv elif [[ $FILE_EXT == "xlsx" ]]; then echo "processing $FILE as $FILE_EXT with table name $TABLE_NAME" iconv -t UTF-8 -c $FILE | in2csv > formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv fi if [[ -z formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv ]]; then echo "$FILE has a file extension that is not implemented ($FILE_EXT) or could not be converted to csv." else echo "file formatted - moving to create table script" #limit the type analysis to first 10k rows to avoid crazy processing times head -n 10000 formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv | csvsql -v --no-constraints --blanks --db-schema ${SCHEMA_NAME} --tables ${TABLE_NAME} -i postgresql > table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql #replace the default boolean type with varchar (prevents errors when first 10k vals of column are null but vals exist later) sed -i 's/BOOLEAN/VARCHAR/g' table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql
echo "dropping and recreating table from generated sql script then importing formatted data" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${SCHEMA_NAME}.${TABLE_NAME}" \ -c "\i table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql" \ -c "\COPY ${SCHEMA_NAME}.${TABLE_NAME} from formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv CSV HEADER NULL 'NA'"; fi elif [[ $FILE == *"manifest"* ]]; then TABLE_NAME='manifest'; echo "processing manifest file into resources schema"; iconv -t UTF-8 -c $FILE | csvformat -t > formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv
head -n 10000 formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv | csvsql -v --no-constraints --blanks --db-schema resources --tables ${TABLE_NAME} -i postgresql > table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql
PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS resources.${TABLE_NAME}" \ -c "\i table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql" \ -c "\COPY resources.${TABLE_NAME} from formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv CSV HEADER"; elif [[ $FILE == *"telemetry"* ]]; then TABLE_NAME='telemetry_report'; echo "build telemetry report table into resources schema"; iconv -t UTF-8 -c $FILE | csvformat -t > formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv
head -n 20 formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv | csvsql -v --no-constraints --blanks -I --db-schema resources --tables ${TABLE_NAME} -i postgresql > table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql
PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS resources.${TABLE_NAME}" \ -c "\i table_scripts/${TABLE_NAME}.sql" \ -c "\COPY resources.${TABLE_NAME} from formatted_files/$TABLE_NAME.csv CSV HEADER" \ -c "UPDATE resources.${TABLE_NAME} set \"CONSENT\" = ('c'||\"CONSENT\")"; else echo "could not extract table name from $FILE, assuming it is a non-data file and skipping" fi unset FILE_EXT; unset TABLE_NAME; done < file_list.txt
#set all column names to lowercase echo "normalizing column names stage 1: setting all columns to lowercase" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -o go_to_lower -t -c "select 'ALTER TABLE ${SCHEMA_NAME}.'||quote_ident(table_name)||' RENAME COLUMN '||quote_ident(column_name) || ' TO ' || lower(quote_ident(column_name))||';' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = '${SCHEMA_NAME}' and lower(quote_ident(column_name)) != quote_ident(column_name)" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\g go_to_lower" -c "\i go_to_lower" echo "normalizing column names stage 2: replacing spaces with _" #replace spaces in column names with _ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -o update_spaces -t -c "select 'ALTER TABLE ${SCHEMA_NAME}.'||quote_ident(table_name)||' RENAME COLUMN '||quote_ident(column_name) || ' TO ' || lower(quote_ident(replace(column_name, ' ', '_')))||';' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = '${SCHEMA_NAME}' and lower(quote_ident(column_name)) != quote_ident(column_name)" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\g update_spaces" -c "\i update_spaces" echo "normalizing column names stage 3: fixing 'conecpt_cd' typo to 'concept_cd' to keep consistent" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -o update_conecpt_cd -t \ -c "select 'ALTER TABLE ${SCHEMA_NAME}.'||quote_ident(table_name)||' RENAME COLUMN '||quote_ident(column_name) || ' TO concept_cd;' from information_schema.columns where table_schema = '${SCHEMA_NAME}' and quote_ident(column_name) = 'conecpt_cd'" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\g update_conecpt_cd" -c "\i update_conecpt_cd"
